Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer (Python, React) to join our team and take ownership of designing, building, and maintaining scalable back-end systems while collaborating on full-stack initiatives.
 Responsibilities
Develop and maintain APIs and server-side logic using Python and FastAPI
Design, manage, and optimize PostgreSQL databases
Write and maintain unit tests and test scripts using Playwright and PyTest to ensure application quality
Optimize database queries and back-end performance
Use GitHub for version control and code collaboration
Deploy applications using Docker and manage cloud services on Azure
Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform and orchestrate services with Kubernetes
Integrate GraphQL APIs to optimize data fetching and improve performance
Stay updated with the latest back-end technologies and best practices
 Requirements
5+ years of experience in Python development with FastAPI
Proficiency in SQL, particularly PostgreSQL
Skills in test automation with Playwright and unit testing with PyTest
Knowledge of containerization with Docker and familiarity with cloud services, particularly Azure
Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
Understanding of infrastructure as code with Terraform and orchestration with Kubernetes
Experience integrating GraphQL APIs
Familiarity with React for full-stack collaboration or API integration
Experience with agile methodologies
Excellent communication skills, a curious and proactive mindset, and a hands-on, can-do approach
English proficiency at B2 level or higher
 We offer
Full access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
Free English classes
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
Friendly team and comfortable working environment
Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
Flexible working schedule
Opportunities for self-realization
